# Board meeting, 2026-03-19

Held at the Clearwater Grange hall. Six of seven trustees present.

## Ending overdue fines

The board took up the [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]] proposal. Ines Barrow presented the [[Pilot results - Pinecrest no-charge summer#Returns]]: items came back at the same rate, and 212 blocked cardholders returned to borrowing once their balances were cleared. The treasurer noted that late charges brought in 23,000 dollars in 2025, about 1.4 percent of the budget, and that staff spent hours each week handling disputes.

One trustee asked whether patrons would stop returning books. The pilot showed no change in return times. The motion passed five to one.

## Other business

The board approved the spring hours schedule and thanked the Friends group for the book sale.
